baseline.method: Actual GND Gerber islands minus actual Excellon holes; rebuild island union through exported GND barrel wall boundaries on their real spans. Component terminals inside holes seed actual annular copper, never the empty drill center.
limits: Ground-only connectivity check; no SI, impedance, return-current distribution or fabrication qualification.
Metal assignment uses the no-short pre-drill net graph, but connectivity is recomputed entirely after subtracting actual drill shapes.
